objective: Turn the nine archived runner QA findings into an exact independently testable additive engineering successor protocol.
scope: Zero-run Coordinator repair planning only; preserve predecessor nine-finding question and constraints verbatim plus explicit isolation.

controls.required_disposition: Required execution_approval v1 interface and source/plan authority are absent
controls.required_repair_boundary: Create a separately scoped additive adapter/schema successor preserving the mandated v1 envelope and complete source/plan/approval bindings; keep this archived version intact. Validate a complete synthetic instance of that real interface and its malformed controls.

controls.required_disposition: Reserved configuration membership is not checked and source-v2 entries are not wired launch interfaces
controls.required_repair_boundary: Wire a gated additive entry CLI/child interface, derive exact seven configurations and paths from hash-pinned immutable definitions, and refuse mismatches before imports/output. Exercise only benign forwarding sentinels during engineering tests; real scientific authority remains separately required.

controls.required_disposition: Claim and native provenance checks do not enforce the complete bound authority
controls.required_repair_boundary: Bind and compare all canonical claim fields and the actual native receipt, verify acquisition/expiry and task/run membership, validate the decision reference, refuse prohibited/fallback/degraded provenance, and preserve exact observed provenance in the terminal record.

controls.required_disposition: Executable, import closure and environment declarations are not enforced
controls.required_repair_boundary: Compare normalized argv[0] and runtime version/hash to the pinned executable, establish and verify complete import/dependency closure, and launch with an explicitly constructed allowed environment. Record actual pins and companion values.

controls.required_disposition: Launch-time revalidation and independent postflight bindings are missing
source_limitations: No actual completed_valid bypass was demonstrated. Missing postflight checks are established by source plus per-check diagnostics; clean-tree end-to-end validity remains untested.
controls.required_repair_boundary: Revalidate current claim, immutable launch data, lock/spec/source file identity and approved Git state before mkdir/exec; automatically bind all protocol files and compare them independently after child quiescence. Provide an explicitly approved synthetic fixture tree-state policy so a clean positive case can be tested without masking specific negative controls.

controls.required_disposition: Output allowlist and no-clobber protections fail for child artifacts
controls.required_repair_boundary: Use canonical paths, exclusive non-following file creation and inode/link checks for every parent-owned artifact; validate complete final directory membership, missing outputs and all hashes; fsync the exclusive terminal manifest last. Preserve already-produced collision/failure evidence in a distinct permitted terminal diagnostic.

controls.required_disposition: Both frozen output profiles and current ledger manifests are incomplete
controls.required_repair_boundary: Emit the existing run envelope with current fields and all original plus authorized companion paths; preserve both text-log names for both profiles. Validate real synthetic terminal files using the applicable ledger checks and current schema before claiming engineering completion.

controls.required_disposition: Resource checks have scoped successes but terminal classification and schema types remain incomplete
controls.required_repair_boundary: Retain the observed resource mechanisms, require exact integer types, refuse unquiesced groups in final validity, preserve cause-specific terminal states with all postflight failures, and disclose RSS sampling uncertainty. Validate success/failure/timeout/memory classifications under a legitimate clean synthetic setup.

controls.required_disposition: Producer completion and coverage claims exceed the archived evidence
controls.required_repair_boundary: Coordinator records an additive incomplete/failed engineering disposition without rewriting the archived report. Any successor must supply actual task-calibrated native provenance and demonstrate every claimed control through the admitted interface; obtain independent review of its committed snapshot.

success: Each finding has an old observed failure/current source comparison and concrete source-preserving successor implementation and synthetic test obligation; complete four-card proposed executor/snapshot/fresh QA/decision-only ledger chain with allocated IDs.
negative: Record exact contract ambiguity or remaining missing prerequisite without inventing current fixes or scientific failure.
inconclusive: Preserve bounded partial planning and exact unresolved fields; no downstream admission.
stop: Stop after four deliverables or checkpoint on watchdog; stop admission for changed predecessor owner/epoch, live/completed claim or late output.

inference.child_runtime_binding: Parent records actual fresh child after dispatch; do not equate control-plane session with child.

proof_search_map.applicability: Not a proof-oriented proposal or mathematical experiment: operational repair planning only.
proof_search_map.exact_baseline_reproduction: Frozen QA artifacts are source evidence; no tests executed by planner.
proof_search_map.observation_collision: Separate dirty-tree terminal classification from actual admission defects; no completed_valid bypass inferred.
proof_search_map.quantifier_order: Every one of nine findings needs exact scoped disposition; no global runner correctness claim.
proof_search_map.method_ceiling: Planning and synthetic future controls cannot establish scientific correctness or launch readiness.
